briefing.headline: FOIL spikes 26.3% while AAOX plunges 25.0% amid mixed moves in mega‑cap tech
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech showed modest activity: AMZN, TSLA, MSFT and META posted modest gains, AAPL slipped slightly and NVDA was flat, while SPY edged up. In contrast, small‑cap and leveraged tokens swung wildly, with FOIL up 26.3% and TRAX up 20.8% on the upside and AAOX down 25.0% and SOXL down 15.0% on the downside. The breadth was narrow among core names but extremely broad among niche tickers, indicating sector‑specific volatility rather than a market‑wide shift.
